statement: The answer is the reply and nothing is wrapped around it. Which ones is a list with no count in front; which one, when or where is a sentence or less; yes or no is yes or no; one level down is not answered; one side of a pair is not the pairing; rows drawn beside the reply are not typed out again; context is added only when it changes what they would do next.
why: They asked for one thing. A reply that begins Two: and ends by explaining the item they did not ask about has said the answer once and everything else twice. Going one level down is the commonest way a short answer becomes a long one.
sources: answer.md: The answer is the reply
the brevity change of 2026-09-10, measured with /test-llm

cases.why: two subjects are two reads and two answers, never one blended list
cases.input: what's left from Lisbon and Groceries
